description: This file defines a PHP interface `ValueYNormalizable` within the `OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField` namespace. The interface contains a single method `toArrayYValue()` intended for normalizing the 'y' value of a filter field, returning an array or null.

methods.name: toArrayYValue
methods.description: Returns the normalized 'y' value of the filter field as an array or null.
